content.text:
`slugify` is implemented in `src/strings.js`, and `npm test` passes all 12 tests (the 2 existing ones plus 10 new).

It converts `đ`/`Đ` to `d` first, then strips accents and lowercases. Each run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one hyphen, and leading and trailing hyphens are removed. The result is cut to 50 characters, and any hyphen left at the end of the cut is removed. `null` or `undefined` input returns an empty string.

I added the tests to `test/strings.test.js`. They cover:
- hyphenation and digits
- accents, Vietnamese text and `đ`/`Đ`
- collapsing runs of symbols
- trimming hyphens
- empty and symbol-only input
- the 50-character cut, both when it would leave a trailing hyphen and when it doesn't
